about: THE DESERT HIGHWAY, LEG 1 (One World BUILD_PLAN phase 4.2, 2026-11-17): the Circus' west side to Western Town's north side. The old Highway room's Exit 3 pieces stand on it: the lone Door by the road (the opening scene and the main menu's spot) and the bus stop. The design page: 'wells and a caravan stop on it'.
